text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Our next segment today will be... Twinkle
Spotlight, where we
highlight racers in the
Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
With the Classics fast approaching,
everyone is abuzz about the
stacked
lineup this year. Some are even declaring
this the Golden
Generation of racing!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Among them is this racer, whose carefree
personality conceals her
cunning
front-running strategy—Seiun Sky!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Manipulating the rest of the pack into keeping up with her pace, racing fans have dubbed her the Trickster!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Up next, we have a runner coming off of
three consecutive victories,
including a
graded race—King Halo!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Expectations are high for this racer
considering her family
background, but
her performance has yet to disappoint!
We're all
wondering just how many G1
trophies she'll snatch!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And we can't forget the condor soaring in
from America and snatching
wins left and
right! She is the unstoppable Phantom
Bird... El Condor
Pasa!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Her claim to be the world's strongest racer
doesn't seem to be said in
jest! Her debut
race performance has convinced fans that
she will
indeed prove herself worthy of
that title!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
We also have another Umamusume from
America, Grass Wonder! Her
grace and
poise may be reminiscent of Japanese
beauty, but in her
heart burns the soul of a
samurai!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Taking on the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes
with an undefeated record,
she claimed
the crown of best junior racer in record
time! Since that
fearsome performance,
people have taken to calling her the Beast.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And finally, last but not least, we have a
racer who came all the way
from Hokkaido
to chase her dream, Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Her raw talent led to her transfer to
Tracen Academy, and it was on
full display
at her debut! Fans are already speculating
that she'll play
a significant role in the
Golden Generation!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Just what sort of performance will we
witness at her second race ever?
Will we
all bear witness to a legend in the
making?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This is it... I'm one step closer to becoming
the best in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I can't believe I looooost!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! Losing sucks, doesn't it? It's
okay, just let it all out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To become the best racer in Japan... That
is the dream that brought
Special Week to
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After her debut race ended in a
phenomenal victory, she was excited
for
her second race... which unfortunately
ended with her taking a
close second.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Mom said she was going to watch
my race on TV and cheer me
on too... I was
really rar'n to go...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But I couldn't do it... I just couldn't pass
herrrr!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But you did your best, right?! You fought
so hard, Speeee!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um... Could you two please calm down?
We wouldn't want to interfere
with
anyone's training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I will say though, I was also a bit surprised
by the results. It seemed
like something
tripped you up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You were doing so well in
training...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing wrong with your running. I
wouldn't have you race if
there was.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You definitely have a talent for athletics.
Heck, I'd say your
abilities—particularly
your final push at the end—are on track to
rival
Tickezo and Brian.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Stamina-wise, you catch your breath after
running fairly quickly, so I
don't foresee
any issues increasing the race distance
either.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Stamina-wise, you catch your breath after
running fairly quickly, so I
don't foresee
any issues increasing the race distance
either.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Only issue I can see... is that she's wet
behind the ears.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What about my ears?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Before Tracen, you never ran with other
Umamusume, right? Running
by yourself
and running with a whole pack of racers
are worlds apart.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You can't expect a course that plays to
your strengths or a
comfortable pace. It's
all about learning how to crush your
opponents
anytime and anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That's right! And experience will get you
there!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Mm-hm! Besides, you've only lost once.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Don't forget, we've got your back! When you fall, we'll be there to catch ya! So go ahead and crash into any obstacles at full speed!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well, maybe don't... go that far.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But it is true that you have our full
support.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe, why don't we all start running
together more? If it's experience
you
need, that's probably the best solution.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka... You guys...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll add more practice races to
our regimen! Now that we
know what we
need to work on, all that's left is to move
forward!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll add more practice races to
our regimen! Now that we
know what we
need to work on, all that's left is to move
forward!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right! We certainly don't want to move backwards!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I made a promise to my mom! I've got to
become the best racer in all
of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Urraaaugh! Here I goooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week throws herself fully into her
practice races, and before
long, she's
shaken free of the stupor her loss put her
in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching her go, I'm reminded of the day I
first scouted her. Just like
back then, her
running seems to embody the earnest
desire to achieve
her dreams.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Excellent work, Special Week. I believe
that concludes today's
training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You really showed that vicious training
who's boss! Which makes
sense, seeing as
you're MY protege!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... You've all been working so hard for me, so I knew I had to return the favor!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
If we keep this up, you'll get a feel for
racing in no time. But that's
enough for
today. Let's just finish off with a cooldow—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, actually... do you think I could run just
a little more? I think I can
keep going.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, don'tcha think you're going
overboard?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, what can I say? I just want to run!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You see... I don't actually know how I'm
going to become the best
racer in Japan
yet.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I need to achieve something big if I want
to proudly tell my mom that
I've become
the best in Japan. But no matter how much
I think about
it, I can't figure out what that
is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
True, "the best racer in Japan" is a rather
vague concept. It could
refer to your
record or some singular, historic
accomplishment.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right. But sitting around thinking about it
all the time isn't gonna get
me anywhere,
so I figured I should take it one step at a
time and
focus on what I can achieve now.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And you know what? Running with you all
gave me an idea!
Something that'll get me
just a teeeensy bit closer to my goal!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Becoming a Triple Crown champion!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Comin' outta the gates runnin', I see!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, Derby, and finally the
Kikuka Sho... Winning even
one of those
races takes top-level skills.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'd say surviving all those interviews after
taking the Triple Crown was
just as hard...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well yeah, what'd you expect?! The Triple
Crown's the HIGHEST of
honors!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And I need to aim for the top if I want my dream to come true. I guess you could say the path from Hokkaido to all of Japan is the high road!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whether the Triple Crown champion could
be considered the best
racer in all of
Japan would certainly make for a hot
debate...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But considering the scale of her dream, I
think it's a fitting goal for
the immediate
future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose such a big goal would
indeed warrant a more
intensive training
regimen.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Right. If that's what you want, Spe, then
all I can say is yes! Now... get
back to
training!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Right. If that's what you want, Spe, then
all I can say is yes! Now... get
back to
training!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay! Be right back!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No way am I letting you have all the fun!
Wait up! Let's do some
partner runnin'!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's no wonder why you invited
Special Week to join our team.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after facing defeat, she bounces back
more determined than
ever...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That steadfast optimism of hers is exactly
why I want to help her
make her dreams
come true.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Spe! The road to the Triple Crown
is long and winding! Do
fifty laps on the
dirt course, ON THE DOUBLE!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: FIFTY?! N-no waaay!
